object.definition: The unknown real payoff is $f:X\times Y\to\mathbb R$, with primal variable $x\in X\subset\mathbb R^{d_x}$ and dual variable $y\in Y\subset\mathbb R^{d_y}$.

assumption.description: The set $X$ is known, nonempty, closed, and convex. The set $Y$ is known, nonempty, compact, and convex, with $\operatorname{diam}(Y)\le D_y$. This setting uses $X=\mathbb R^{d_x}$.
